Edit target_cells change crop size.
code: adata_full <- anndata$read_h5ad(brain_path)  coords <- py_to_r(py_get_item(adata_full$obsm, "spatial"))[, 1:2, drop = FALSE] x <- coords[, 1] y <- coords[, 2]  # Size a square window, centered on the tissue, to capture ~target_cells. n_total <- nrow(coords) frac    <- min(1, target_cells / n_total) cx      <- median(x) cy      <- median(y) half_x  <- (diff(range(x)) / 2) * sqrt(frac) half_y  <- (diff(range(y)) / 2) * sqrt(frac)  in_window <- x >= (cx - half_x) & x <= (cx + half_x) &              y >= (cy - half_y) & y <= (cy + half_y)  cat("Cells kept:", sum(in_window), "of", n_total, "\n")  py$adata_full <- adata_full py$in_window <- r_to_py(which(in_window) - 1L)   # 0-based indices for Python adata <- py_eval("adata_full[in_window].copy()", convert = FALSE)  # Store the feature matrix as a named layer and add a sample label. py_set_item(adata$layers, "layer 1", adata$X) n_cells <- as.integer(py_to_r(adata$n_obs)) py_set_item(adata$obs, "sample_id", r_to_py(rep("mouse_brain", n_cells)))  adata$write_h5ad(h5ad_path) adata

title: repSpatWorkshop
text: Python package detecting repeated spatial patterns spatial omics data, defined tissue regions spatially separated share similar underlying cell-type biological profile distributions. package provides nonparametric statistical inference framework integrates spatially constrained clustering followed spatial invariance testing clusters using block-permutation procedure based maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) statistic. enables formal hypothesis testing repeated spatial patterns. also works natively AnnData .h5ad files, standard format single-cell spatial omics workflows, making suitable exploration analysis spatial omics datasets. repSpat currently available GitHub python package. workshop demonstrating functionalities repspat R using reticulate.
code: library(reticulate) reticulate::py_install("git+https://github.com/amanpreet60/repspat.git") repspat <- import("repspat", convert = FALSE)

title: repSpatWorkshop
text: end workshop, participants able : Understand goal repeated spatial pattern detection. Apply constrained agglomerative hierarchical clustering (CAHC) obtain spatially contiguous clusters. Perform pairwise comparisons cluster distributions using maximum mean discrepancy squared (MMD2) statistic. Approximate null distribution MMD2 statistic using block permutation preserving local dependence. Reassign cluster labels based pairwise similarity. Interpret repeated spatial patterns try workflow different data types.
